name: Eos
summary: Eos is a Berkeley hybrid optical detector demonstrator that integrates Cherenkov and scintillation detection techniques. It tests the photon timing, calibration and reconstruction methods needed for large future neutrino detectors such as Theia.
detection_principle: Fast photomultipliers measure photon arrival times and positions in water and scintillating media. Separating prompt directional Cherenkov photons from scintillation light is intended to combine event direction with calorimetric energy measurement.

results.summary: Single-photon LED pulses demonstrated integration of the detector and calibration system. First light does not imply observation of neutrinos.
